newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & McLennan Q4 insurance revs down.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan Q4 insurance revs down.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said fourth quarter insurance services revenues were $448.7 million, down from $475.1 million a year ago.
Revenue from Marsh & McLennan's investment management business rose to $307.0 million in the fourth quarter from $211.3 million a year ago.
The consulting business reported fourth quarter revenues of $296.8 million compared to $271.9 million a year ago, Marsh & McLennan said.
For the year, insurance services revenue fell to $1.91 billion compared to $1.96 billion in 1995.
Investment management revenue rose to $1.08 billion compared to $750 million a year ago.
Revenue from the consulting business rose to $1.12 billion compared to $1.06 billion in 1995.
"We are pleased with the company's results, particularly Putnam's exceptional performance, which drove our double-digit revenue and earnings gains," Marsh & McLennan Chairman A.J.C. Smith said.
"Looking ahead, we are optimistic about the growth prospects for our businesses in 1997," Smith said.
